source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.8.2, printed page 15.

blocks.text: Sodium oxygen mein golden yellow (sunehri peeli) flame (lau) ke saath jalta hai aur sodium oxide aur sodium peroxide ka safed solid mixture banata hai. Sodium ko kerosene oil (mitti ka tel) mein dooba kar rakha jata hai taake hawa se react na kare. Khuli hawa mein yeh oxygen se zor se react kar ke peroxide banata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 2Na(s) + O₂(g) → 2Na₂O₂(s) chhapa hai, jo balanced nahi: baen taraf 2 Na atoms aur daen taraf 4. Sahi: 2Na(s) + O₂(g) → Na₂O₂(s).
Khaas conditions (halaat) mein, jaise oxygen kam ho ya temperature zyada ho, sodium oxide banta hai.
Magnesium oxygen mein tez safed flame ke saath jalta hai aur safed solid magnesium oxide banata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 2MgO(g) chhapa hai, yani gas. Magnesium oxide safed solid hai (jaisa upar wali line khud kehti hai), is liye sahi 2MgO(s) hai.
Magnesium ka powder tez safed flame ke saath bohat tezi se jalta hai. Isi liye ise fireworks (aatishbazi) aur S.O.S. flares (madad ke signal) mein istemal kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium ko kerosene oil mein kyun rakha jata hai, aur oxygen ke saath yeh kaun se do products de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sodium hawa ki oxygen (aur nami) se zor se react karta hai; kerosene oil hawa ko is se door rakhta hai. Khuli hawa (zyada oxygen) mein yeh sodium peroxide, Na₂O₂, banata hai; kam oxygen ya zyada temperature par sodium oxide, Na₂O.

items: Sodium golden yellow flame se jalta hai: 2Na + O₂ → Na₂O₂ (peroxide), kam oxygen mein 4Na + O₂ → 2Na₂O; ise kerosene oil mein rakhte hain.
Magnesium tez safed flame se jal kar safed solid MgO banata hai: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO; is flame ka istemal fireworks aur flares mein hota hai.
